_status_note: PROPOSED is never binding. Registration = Daniel approves, status set to REGISTERED with a future effective_utc and the code commit, then `mercer_dev.py register` logs the SHA-256. The file is frozen from then on.
change_control: New version for any change to features, weights, model family, market blending, eligibility, edge or divergence thresholds, markets, sizing, exposure or data-quality rules. Ratings and rolling inputs updating is not a new version. Clerical amendments are separate logged files and may not touch methodology fields. No version is ever applied retroactively.
data_sources: The Odds API v4 event odds (h2h, spreads, totals; US region; Tier-1 books)
ESPN scoreboard (event identity, schedule, status, finals)
Human research notes under the D.J. Mercer byline (injury feed, depth charts, news)

feature_definitions.confidence: standard | strong | spotlight; an ordering, never a probability, never changes stake
feature_definitions.edge_pts: 100 * (reference_probability - market_implied_probability); usually <= 0 and published as it is
feature_definitions.market_implied_probability: implied probability of the American price taken
feature_definitions.reference_probability: median over fresh Tier-1 books quoting the same number of p_side/(p_side+p_other), implied from American odds

known_limitations: No model edge: the best blend weight on 2022-24 is 0 (docs/MERCER_DEVELOPMENTAL_PROTOCOL.md section 4).
Selections are human judgement; no historical record of this process exists before effective_utc.
No untouched historical test; the 2025 holdout is deliberately not spent.
CLV for spreads and totals needs a closing capture per play that is not yet scheduled.
Per-market timestamps depend on the provider supplying them; missing ones block release.

manual_review.approval_binds: the full artifact SHA-256, including the exact Discord payload
manual_review.period: every play until 8 weeks after effective_utc or 30 plays in this cohort, whichever is later

max_market_divergence.note: no model disagreement exists at w=0; divergence is controlled as price vs consensus and the recorded walk-away boundary. 3.0 pts admits an ordinary -110/-110 number (2.38 pts below proportional fair) and blocks a price materially worse than that.

model_type: market reference probability: median proportionally de-vigged Tier-1 consensus at the exact number, at selection time. Model weight w = 0.
selection_source: D.J. Mercer research process (docs/MERCER_SPOTLIGHT.md sections 2b-2c: Research Filter v1.0, independent-case rule, required Case Against, walk-away boundary recorded before the number is checked).

selection_time.note: the artifact is built from a quote no older than max_quote_age_minutes and re-checked at publication

training_window: 2022-2023 NFL regular season, T-24 Tier A odds (market blend weight); ratings burn-in 2010-14, tuned 2015-21 (fb-v0.1, frozen). CONTAMINATED: previously scored.

unit_sizing.basis: recorded paper stake; no staking claim

untouched_test_window: none. See docs/MERCER_DEVELOPMENTAL_PROTOCOL.md section 6; the live record from effective_utc is the only untouched evidence.
validation_window: 2024 NFL regular season. CONTAMINATED: previously scored.
